chemistry-e1-l1.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-e1-l1.concept: Ihe na-eme ihe bụ ihe a na-akpọ ngwa. Metal, plastik, gilaasị na rọba nwere àgwà pụrụ iche nke ọ bụla.
chemistry-e1-l1.example: A na-eji gilaasị doro anya nke na-ekwe ka ìhè gafere mee windo, ma a na-eji rọba na-agbatị agbatị ma siri ike mee taya.

chemistry-e1-l2.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa · Nyocha nnwale na idozi nsogbu
chemistry-e1-l2.concept: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa: Na-ewulite ikike nke nkọwa data nnwale na idozi nsogbu ojiji n'ezi ndụ.
chemistry-e1-l2.example: Site na nyocha data ọnụọgụ na nyocha njehie, nweta nkwubi okwu nyocha sayensị.

chemistry-e2-l1.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-e2-l1.concept: Mgbe ihe na-agwakọta nke ọma n'ime mmiri ma a naghịzi ahụ ya, a na-akpọ ya 'mgbaze (dissolving)'. Ihe na-agbaghị agbaze na-ada n'ala ma ọ bụ na-efe n'elu.
chemistry-e2-l1.example: Nnu na-agbaze doo anya n'ime mmiri, ma aja anaghị agbaze, ọ na-ada n'ala.

chemistry-e2-l2.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta · Nyocha nnwale na idozi nsogbu
chemistry-e2-l2.concept: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta: Na-ewulite ikike nke nkọwa data nnwale na idozi nsogbu ojiji n'ezi ndụ.
chemistry-e2-l2.example: Site na nyocha data ọnụọgụ na nyocha njehie, nweta nkwubi okwu nyocha sayensị.

chemistry-e3-l1.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-e3-l1.concept: Ihe siri ike nwere ụdị na oke edoziri. Mmiri na-agbanwe ụdị dabere n'ihe e debere ya n'ime, ma oke ya na-adị otu. Gas na-agbanwe ma ụdị ma oke n'efu.
chemistry-e3-l1.example: Ice (ihe siri ike), mmiri (liquid) na ikuku mmiri (gas) bụ ọnọdụ atọ nke mmiri.

chemistry-e4-l1.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-e4-l1.concept: Mgbe mmiri na-aghọ gas ọ bụ vaporization (evaporation, ịsị), mgbe gas na-aghọ mmiri ọ bụ liquefaction (condensation), ma mgbe ihe siri ike na-aghọ mmiri ọ bụ fusion.
chemistry-e4-l1.example: Mgbe mmiri na-ejikọta n'oge oyi, oke ya na-abawanye, ya mere kan ihe ọṅụṅụ ma ọ bụ karama PET na-agbaba.

chemistry-e5-l1.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-e5-l1.concept: Ihe na-agbaze bụ solute, mmiri na-agbaze bụ solvent, ma mmiri a gwakọtara nke ọma bụ solution. N'ime solution, ụtọ, agba, na nchịkọta bụ otu n'akụkụ ọ bụla e wepụrụ.
chemistry-e5-l1.example: Mgbe e gbazere nnu (solute) n'ime mmiri (solvent), ọ na-aghọ mmiri nnu (solution).

chemistry-e6-l1.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-e6-l1.concept: Ngwọta acid (mmanya, ihe lemon) na-eme ka akwụkwọ litmus acha anụnụ anụnụ ghọọ uhie, ma ngwọta base (mmiri ncha) na-eme ka akwụkwọ litmus uhie ghọọ acha anụnụ anụnụ. Ọkụ chọrọ ihe na-agba ọkụ, oxygen, na okpomọkụ n'elu ebe ọkụ na-amalite.
chemistry-e6-l1.example: Ọ bụrụ na a tinye mmanya n'ime red cabbage indicator, ọ na-aghọ uhie, ma ọ bụrụ na a tinye mmiri ncha, ọ na-aghọ acha anụnụ anụnụ/odo odo.

chemistry-m1-l1.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-m1-l1.concept: Mgbe okpomọkụ dị otu, oke gas na-adịkọ n'ụzọ opposite na nrụgide (iwu Boyle: $PV=\text{mgbe niile}$). Mgbe nrụgide dị otu, oke gas na-adịkọ na okpomọkụ (iwu Charles).
chemistry-m1-l1.example: Ọ bụrụ na e tinye bọọlụ ping-pong e gbagbuo n'ime mmiri ọkụ, mmegharị nke ụmụ gas na-aga n'ihu ma bọọlụ na-agbasa tọgbọ chakoo.

chemistry-m1-l2.concept: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ: Na-ewulite ikike nke nkọwa data nnwale na idozi nsogbu ojiji n'ezi ndụ.

chemistry-m2-l1.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-m2-l1.concept: Element bụ ihe bụ isi e ji mee ihe. Mgbe atom na-efunahụ electron ọ na-aghọ cation, mgbe ọ na-enweta ya ọ na-aghọ anion. Mgbe ion ụfọdụ zutere, ha na-emepụta precipitate na-agbaghị agbaze n'ime mmiri.
chemistry-m2-l1.example: Mgbe e wụsara silver nitrate solution n'ime sodium chloride solution, a na-emepụta precipitate silver chloride ($\text{AgCl}$) ọcha.

chemistry-m3-l1.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-m3-l1.concept: Tupu na mgbe mmeghachi omume kemịkal gasịrị, ụdị na ọnụọgụ atom anaghị agbanwe, ya mere a na-echekwa oke niile. N'ime compound, oke dị n'etiti element ndị ya na-adị otu.
chemistry-m3-l1.example: Hydrogen $1\text{ g}$ na oxygen $8\text{ g}$ na-ejikọta mepụta mmiri $9\text{ g}$ (oke ruru $1:8$).

chemistry-h1-l1.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi
chemistry-h1-l1.concept: Element na-etolite njikọ ionic ma ọ bụ njikọ covalent iji mezuo octet rule (nhazi electron nke otu 18). Oxidation bụ ịfunahụ electron, reduction bụ inweta electron.
chemistry-h1-l1.example: Sodium chloride ($\text{NaCl}$) anaghị ebufe ọkụ eletrik mgbe ọ bụ ihe siri ike, ma ọ bụrụ na e gbazee ya n'ime mmiri, ion na-agagharị ma ọkụ eletrik na-agba.

chemistry-h3-l1.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal · Nyocha mbụ na ụkpụrụ isi

chemistry-e1-q1.prompt: N'ime ndị a, kedu nke jikọtara 'ihe (ọkpụrụkpụ)' nwere ụdị doro anya na ojiji pụrụ iche na 'ihe e ji mee ya (ngwa)' ziri ezi?

options.a: oche (ihe) — osisi (ngwa)
options.b: iko gilaasị (ihe) — iko (ngwa)
options.c: igwe (ihe) — mkpa (ngwa)
options.d: plastik (ihe) — ọkwa (ngwa)

hints: 'Ihe' bụ aha ihe e mechara a na-eji, 'ngwa' bụ aha ihe e ji mee ya.
Oche bụ ihe, osisi bụ ngwa e ji mee ya.
chemistry-e1-q1.explanation: Ihe nwere ụdị na ojiji bụ 'ihe', ma ihe bụ isi e ji mee ihe ahụ bụ 'ngwa'.

chemistry-e1-q2.prompt: Kedu àgwà pụrụ iche nke ihe dị ka rọba ma ọ bụ bọlụn, nke na-agbatị mgbe e dọrọ ya ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe e hapụrụ ya?

options.a: ịgbatị na ịlaghachi (elasticity)
options.b: ịdị doro anya (transparency)
options.c: magnet (magnetism)
options.d: ọkụ ịbụ ihe na-agba ọkụ (flammability)

hints: Ọ bụ àgwà ịlaghachi n'ụdị mbụ.
Chee echiche banyere ike na-agbapụ nke rọba.
chemistry-e1-q2.explanation: Àgwà nke ihe e gbanwere site n'ike ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe ike ahụ kwụsịrị bụ 'ịgbatị na ịlaghachi (elasticity)'.

chemistry-e1-q3.prompt: Kedu nke jikọtara àgwà nke ihe e ji mee 'uwe mmiri ozuzo' na 'ugogbe anya mmiri' (iji gwuo mmiri) ziri ezi?

options.a: uwe mmiri ozuzo: na-egbochi mmiri ịgafe / ugogbe anya mmiri: doro anya, a na-ahụ ihe nke ọma
options.b: uwe mmiri ozuzo: na-ebu ọkụ eletrik nke ọma / ugogbe anya mmiri: na-agbaji ngwa ngwa
options.c: uwe mmiri ozuzo: na-agba ọkụ nke ọma / ugogbe anya mmiri: dị arọ
options.d: uwe mmiri ozuzo: na-amị mmiri nke ọma / ugogbe anya mmiri: adịghị ahụ ụzọ

hints: Uwe mmiri ozuzo agaghị ekwe mmiri banye, ma ugogbe anya mmiri kwesịrị ịhụ ihe nke ọma.
A na-ekpebi ojiji dabere n'àgwà ihe.
chemistry-e1-q3.explanation: A na-eji ihe na-egbochi mmiri (vinyl/plastik) mee uwe mmiri ozuzo ka mmiri ghara ịdị ya, ma a na-eji plastik ma ọ bụ gilaasị doro anya mee ugogbe anya mmiri ka a hụ ihe n'okpuru mmiri.

chemistry-e1-q4.prompt: Gịnị bụ ihe sayensị kpatara na a na-eji igwe mee ahụ ite ma ọ bụ nkwụ nri n'ụlọ nri, ma eji plastik ma ọ bụ osisi mee aka ya?

options.a: N'ihi na igwe na-ebufe okpomọkụ ngwa ngwa, ma plastik na osisi adịghị ebufe ya nke ọma, ya mere aka anaghị ere ọkụ
options.b: N'ihi na aka igwe dị ezigbo ọkụ
options.c: N'ihi na plastik na-eme ka nri tọọ ụtọ
options.d: Iji mee oghere n'ahụ ite

hints: Ka e sie nri, okpomọkụ ga-ebufe ngwa ngwa n'ala ite.
A pụghị ijide aka ma ọ bụrụ na ọ na-ekpo ọkụ.
chemistry-e1-q4.explanation: Igwe na-ebufe okpomọkụ nke ọma, ya mere e nwere ike isi nri ngwa ngwa, ma plastik na osisi na-egbochi okpomọkụ, ya mere a pụrụ ijide aka ya mgbe a na-esi nri na-ere ọkụ.

chemistry-e1-c.prompt: [Nyocha gbasara gburugburu ebe obibi] Plastik dị ọkụ, siri ike, ọ naghịkwa rere ure, ma mgbe e tụfuru ya, ọ naghị ere n'okike ruo narị afọ ọtụtụ, ya mere ọ na-emebi gburugburu. Kedu ụzọ ọganihu sayensị ihe ziri ezi iji dozie nke a?

options.a: Ịmepụta 'plastik nke ihe ndị dị ndụ na-agbari (biodegradable)' e ji starch ọka bekee mee nke obere ihe ndị dị ndụ na-agbari
options.b: Itufu plastik niile n'oké osimiri ka ha rie n'ala
options.c: Iliri plastik n'ime ala miri emi ma chefuo ya
options.d: Ịgbanwe ihe niile e ji eme ihe ka ha bụrụ nke a na-eji otu ugboro naanị

hints: Ọ bụ ihe ọhụrụ na-enye gburugburu ihe ọma nke obere ihe ndị dị ndụ nwere ike iri ma gbarie.
Ọ bụ teknụzụ biodegradable.
chemistry-e1-c.explanation: Iji belata mmetọ gburugburu ebe obibi, a na-emepụta nke ọma plastik bio nke e ji ihe ọkụ nke osisi mee, nke mgbe oge gafere, obere ihe ndị dị ndụ na-agbari ya ka ọ bụrụ mmiri na carbon dioxide.

chemistry-e1-q5.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na e ji igwe mee mpi ma ọ bụ mkpara ma ọ nọgide n'ime mmiri na ikuku ogologo oge, ọ na-eguzo mmirimmiri ọbara ọbara (nchara). Kedu ụzọ sayensị ihe ziri ezi iji gbochie nke a?

options.a: Ịsa mmanụ n'obere ma ọ bụ ịtee agba iji gbochie ikuku na mmiri ịkpọ ya aka
options.b: Itinye ya n'ime mmiri iji wepụ ikuku
options.c: Ịsacha igwe ahụ kwa ụbọchị na mmiri nnu
options.d: Ịkpọpụ ya nke ọma n'anyanwụ ka ọ kpọọ nku karịa

hints: Ka igwe nwee nchara, ọ chọrọ ma oxygen ma mmiri.
Ịkpuchi elu nwere ike igbochi oxygen na mmiri.
chemistry-e1-q5.explanation: Nchara igwe na-eme site n'ikpe nke oxygen na mmiri, ya mere ịsa mmanụ, itee agba, ma ọ bụ ịkpuchi ya na metal ọzọ na-egbochi ikuku na mmiri ịkpọ ya aka, ma nchara agaghị eme.

chemistry-e2-q1.prompt: Mgbe e tinyere otu ngaji shuga n'ime beaker nwere mmiri ọkụ ma were osisi gilaasị kpoo ya, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere ihe na-eme?

options.a: Ụmụ shuga na-agbawa n'obere nke ukwuu ma gbasaa nke ọma n'ime mmiri niile, ya mere a naghị ahụ ha
options.b: Shuga na-agba ọkụ dịka okwute siri ike n'ala beaker
options.c: Shuga na-ebili n'elu mmiri ma niile na-efe n'ikuku
options.d: Mmiri dị n'ime beaker na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ ojii

hints: Lelee ihe a na-akpọ mgbaze (dissolving).
Ọ na-adị doro anya, ma ọ bụrụ na e detụ ya, ọ ka na-atọ ụtọ.
chemistry-e2-q1.explanation: Mgbe shuga gbaze n'ime mmiri, ụmụ shuga na-agbasa n'etiti ụmụ mmiri nke ọma, ya mere a naghị ahụ ha, ma mmiri shuga na-adị doro anya.

chemistry-e2-q2.prompt: Gịnị mere shuga ji agbaze ngwa ngwa karịa n'iko nwere mmiri ọkụ ma e jiri ya tụnyere iko nwere mmiri oyi?

options.a: N'ihi na ọ bụrụ na okpomọkụ dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-aga n'ihu nke ọma ma na-ewepụ ụmụ shuga ngwa ngwa
options.b: N'ihi na mmiri ọkụ na-eme ka shuga dị jụụ
options.c: N'ihi na ikuku karịrị n'ime mmiri ọkụ
options.d: N'ihi na mmiri oyi na-akwụsị shuga

hints: Ka okpomọkụ dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-aga ngwa ngwa.
Chee echiche mgbe i tinyere shuga n'iko tii ma kpoo ya.
chemistry-e2-q2.explanation: Ka okpomọkụ mmiri dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-eme mmegharị ọkụ nke ọma ma na-agbaje ụmụ shuga ugboro ugboro na ike karịa, ya mere ọsọ mgbaze na-abawanye.

chemistry-e2-q3.prompt: Mgbe e wụsara mmiri nnu na mmiri apịtị n'ime ihe nzacha nwere akwụkwọ nzacha, kedu nke jikọtara ihe fọdụrụ n'elu akwụkwọ nzacha ziri ezi?

options.a: mmiri nnu: ọ dịghị ihe fọdụrụ / mmiri apịtị: ụmụ apịtị fọdụrụ n'elu akwụkwọ nzacha
options.b: mmiri nnu: otu nnu fọdụrụ / mmiri apịtị: ọ dịghị ihe fọdụrụ
options.c: Ma mmiri nnu ma mmiri apịtị agafere akwụkwọ nzacha n'ụzọ niile
options.d: Ma mmiri nnu ma mmiri apịtị niile fọdụrụ n'elu akwụkwọ nzacha

hints: Ụmụ nke ihe gbazere kpamkpam dị obere karịa oghere akwụkwọ nzacha.
Ụmụ apịtị na-agbaghị agbaze na-ejide n'akwụkwọ nzacha.
chemistry-e2-q3.explanation: Nnu gbazere kpamkpam, ya mere ụmụ ya dị obere karịa oghere akwụkwọ nzacha ma niile na-agafe, ma ụmụ apịtị anaghị agbaze, ya mere ha anaghị agafe oghere ma ha na-ebu n'elu.

chemistry-e2-q4.prompt: Kedu mgbanwe ọnọdụ ihe na ụzọ nkewa a na-eji n'ebe a na-eme nnu (salt pan) iji nweta nnu dị ọcha e ri site na mmiri oké osimiri?

options.a: Iji anyanwụ na ikuku wepụ mmiri n'ụdị ikuku mmiri ka naanị kristal nnu fọdụrụ
options.b: Ịsị mmiri oké osimiri ọkụ ka ọ bụrụ ice
options.c: Itinye magnet n'ime mmiri oké osimiri ka o dọta nnu
options.d: Ịzacha ya na sieve ka naanị nnu pụta

hints: Mgbe mmiri oké osimiri e gbasasịrị n'obere n'ebe a na-eme nnu nweta anyanwụ, naanị mmiri na-aghọ ikuku mmiri ma pụọ.
Ọ bụ nkewa ngwakọta site n'ịkpọpụ mmiri (evaporation).
chemistry-e2-q4.explanation: Ọ bụrụ na e debe mmiri oké osimiri n'ebe a na-eme nnu ma anyanwụ na ikuku kpọpụ mmiri ya, naanị mmiri na-aghọ ikuku mmiri pụọ, ma kristal nnu gbazere na-ahụ ọcha.

chemistry-e2-c.prompt: [Nyocha ụkpụrụ miri emi] E nwere mmiri nnu e mere site n'ịgbaze gram 10 nnu n'ime gram 100 mmiri kpamkpam. Gram ole ka mmiri nnu a niile ga-adị ma e jiri ihe nlele eletrik tụọ ya?
hints: Ọ bụrụgodị na nnu agbaze ma a naghị ahụ ya, ọ nwụghị anwụ.
Nchekwa oke: (arọ mmiri) + (arọ nnu) = ?
chemistry-e2-c.explanation: Mgbe ihe na-agbaze, ụmụ solute (nnu) na-agbasa n'etiti ụmụ mmiri n'ụzọ na-adịghị anwụ, ya mere arọ nke ngwọta niile bụ nchikota arọ mmiri na nnu, ya bụ 110 g, nke a na-echekwa kpọmkwem.

chemistry-e2-q5.prompt: Gịnị mere ọ bụrụ na e tinye mmiri na mmanụ nri n'otu karama ma maa ha ike, ma hapụ ha nwa oge, ha na-ekewa ọzọ n'ọtụtụ nhazi abụọ kpamkpam?

options.a: N'ihi na mmanụ nri anaghị agwakọta na mmiri, ma ọ dị mfe karịa mmiri, ya mere ọ na-efe n'elu
options.b: N'ihi na mmanụ nri na-amị mmiri
options.c: N'ihi na mmiri na-ekpo ọkụ karịa mmanụ nri
options.d: N'ihi na mmanụ nri gbazere ka ọ bụrụ ihe siri ike

hints: Mmiri bụ polar, mmanụ bụ non-polar, ya mere ha anaghị agbaze n'ime ibe ha.
Mmanụ dị mfe karịa mmiri (oke ya dị obere), ya mere ọ na-efe n'elu.
chemistry-e2-q5.explanation: Mmiri bụ molekul polar, ma mmanụ nri bụ molekul non-polar, ya mere ha anaghị agwakọta, ma oke mmanụ nri (ihe dị ka 0.92 g/cm³) dị obere karịa nke mmiri (1.0 g/cm³), ya mere ọ na-efe n'elu.

chemistry-e3-q1.prompt: Kedu ọnọdụ ihe nke ụdị ya na-agbanwe n'efu dabere n'ihe e debere ya n'ime, ma oke ya (volume) anaghị agbanwe ma na-anọgide n'otu?

options.a: mmiri (liquid)
options.b: ihe siri ike (solid)
options.c: gas
options.d: plasma

hints: Chee echiche mgbe i na-awụsa mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ara ehi n'iko ọzọ.
Ụdị na-eso iko, ma ọnụ ọgụgụ (oke) adịghị agbanwe.
chemistry-e3-q1.explanation: Mmiri nwere njikọ n'etiti molekul na-agbanwe agbanwe karịa nke ihe siri ike, ya mere ụdị ya na-agbanwe dabere n'ihe e debere ya, ma n'ihi na mkpali dọtara n'etiti molekul na-anọgide, oke ya na-adị otu.

chemistry-e3-q2.prompt: E tinyere mmiri n'otu syringe ma tinye ikuku n'ọzọ, wee kwụsị ọnụ ya na mkpịsị aka ma pịa piston ike. Kedu ihe na-eme?

options.a: Piston nke syringe nwere ikuku na-abanye nke ọma, ma nke nwere mmiri fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara ịbanye
options.b: Syringe nwere mmiri na-abanye karịa nke nwere ikuku
options.c: Ma syringe abụọ niile na-abanye n'ọnụ ya kpamkpam
options.d: Ma syringe abụọ ọ dịghị nke na-agagharị ma ọ bụ obere

hints: Molekul gas dị anya nke ukwuu n'ebe ibe ha nọ, ya mere oghere dị ọtụtụ.
Gas nwere ike ịpịkọta nke ọma, ma mmiri siri ike ịpịkọta.
chemistry-e3-q2.explanation: Gas (ikuku) nwere ebe dị anya nke ukwuu n'etiti molekul, ya mere mgbe a pịrị ya, ọ na-apịkọta ngwa ngwa ma oke ya belata, ma mmiri (liquid) nwere molekul ndị kpọkọtara ma ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ pịkọta.

chemistry-e3-q3.prompt: Kedu àgwà a na-ahụkarị n'ihe siri ike (solid) ndị a na-ahụ n'ebe anyị nọ kwesịrị ekwesị?

options.a: Ụdị na oke ya na-anọgide n'otu ọbụlagodi ma e gbanwee ihe e debere ya n'ime
options.b: Ụdị ya na-agbanwe n'efu dabere n'ihe e debere ya n'ime
options.c: A pụghị ijide ya n'aka ma anya anaghị ahụ ya ma ọlị
options.d: Ọ na-ejupụta oghere niile ma na-agbasa na-enweghị njedebe

hints: Chee echiche mgbe i na-ebuga otu osisi ma ọ bụ nkume n'ime igbe ọzọ.
Ụdị ya anaghị agbanwe.
chemistry-e3-q3.explanation: N'ihe siri ike, ụmụ ya na-ejikọta ọnụ nke ọma n'ụzọ nhazi, ya mere ụdị na oke ya na-anọgide n'otu ọ gbasoghị ike na-abịa site na mpụga.

chemistry-e3-q4.prompt: Mgbe e meghere karama ísì ụtọ n'otu akụkụ ụlọ, nwa oge ka e mesịrị, ísì ụtọ ahụ rutere imi onye nọ n'akụkụ ọzọ nke ụlọ ahụ. Kedu ụkpụrụ sayensị na-akọwa ihe a?

options.a: Ụmụ gas nke ísì ụtọ na-eme mmegharị n'onwe ha ma na-agbasa n'ime ikuku, nke a bụ 'mgbasa (diffusion)'
options.b: N'ihi na mmiri ísì ụtọ ghọrọ ice ma gbagoo n'ala
options.c: N'ihi na molekul ísì ụtọ dọtara imi dịka magnet
options.d: N'ihi na ikuku riri ísì ụtọ ahụ

hints: Ụmụ nke ihe na-anọghị naanị n'otu ebe, ha na-eme mmegharị n'onwe ha ugboro ugboro.
Kedu aha a na-akpọ ihe gas na-agbasa?
chemistry-e3-q4.explanation: Ọnọdụ ebe ụmụ ísì ụtọ na-eme mmegharị n'onwe ha n'efu n'ọtụtụ ụzọ ma na-agbasa site n'ebe nchikọta dị elu gaa n'ebe dị ala, a na-akpọ ya 'mgbasa (diffusion)'.

chemistry-e3-c.prompt: [Nnwale echiche miri emi] Ikuku anaghị ahụ anya, ma ọ nwere arọ (mass) dịka ihe siri ike ma ọ bụ mmiri? Kedu ụzọ nnwale kacha ruuru ka e gosipụta nke a?

options.a: Ịtụ arọ bọọlụ basketball jupụtara n'ikuku na igwe nlele eletrik zuru oke, wee wepụ ikuku ma tụọ ọzọ ka a hụ ọdịiche arọ
options.b: Itụfu bọọlụ elu ka a lee otu ọ na-efe
options.c: Ịkpọ karama gilaasị efu n'anyanwụ ka ọ na-ekpo ọkụ
options.d: Itinye aka n'ime mmiri ka a tụọ ka ọ dị oyi

hints: Gas bụ ihe, ya mere ọ nwere arọ.
Tụnyere akara igwe nlele mgbe ikuku dị n'ime na mgbe ọ na-adịghị.
chemistry-e3-c.explanation: Mgbe e tụrụ arọ bọọlụ jupụtara n'ikuku wee wepụ ikuku ma tụọ ọzọ, a pụrụ ịhụ na arọ ya belatara, nke a na-egosi na ikuku, ọ bụ gas, nwere arọ na ibu.

chemistry-e3-q5.prompt: Mgbe e debere 'ice kpọrọ nkụ (dry ice)' oyi e ji ekpuchi ice cream n'okpomọkụ ụlọ, ọ dịghị mmiri mmiri ọ bụla pụtara, kama ọ na-aghọ gas ozugbo ma na-apụ n'anya. Kedu mgbanwe ọnọdụ a?

options.a: 'Sublimation', ebe ihe siri ike na-aghọ gas ozugbo na-agafeghị n'ọnọdụ mmiri
options.b: 'Fusion (melting)', ebe ihe siri ike na-agbaze ghọọ mmiri
options.c: 'Vaporization', ebe mmiri na-esi ghọọ gas
options.d: 'Liquefaction', ebe gas na-aghọ mmiri

hints: Dry ice bụ carbon dioxide siri ike.
N'ime 1 atm na okpomọkụ ụlọ, ọ na-eme sublimation ozugbo na-agafeghị n'ọnọdụ mmiri.
chemistry-e3-q5.explanation: Dry ice (carbon dioxide siri ike) enweghị ike ịdị n'ọnọdụ mmiri n'okpomọkụ ikuku (1 atm), kama ọ na-aghọ gas ozugbo site n'ihe siri ike, nke a bụ 'sublimation'.

chemistry-e4-q1.prompt: Mgbe e wepụrụ kan ihe ọṅụṅụ oyi n'ime friji wee hapụ ya nwa oge n'elu tebụl, ntanye mmiri pụtara n'elu kan ahụ. Ebee ka mmiri ndị a si bia?

options.a: Ọ bụ ikuku mmiri (gas) nke dị n'ime ikuku na-ezute kan oyi wee gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ mmiri mmiri (condensation)
options.b: Ọ bụ ihe ọṅụṅụ ahụ na-agbapụta n'oghere aluminium nke kan ahụ
options.c: Ọ bụ agba dị n'elu kan gbazere
options.d: Ọ bụ mmiri osisi si n'osisi tebụl pụta

hints: Ikuku mmiri anaghị ahụ anya na-adị n'ikuku mgbe niile.
Mgbe ikuku mmiri na-ezute elu oyi, ọ na-ajụ oyi wee ghọọ mmiri mmiri (condensation).
chemistry-e4-q1.explanation: Ikuku mmiri dị n'ime ikuku na-ezute elu kan oyi, na-efunahụ okpomọkụ, wee gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ mmiri mmiri, nke a bụ 'condensation (liquefaction)'.

chemistry-e4-q2.prompt: Mgbe mmiri mmiri na-ejikọta ka ọ bụrụ ice siri ike, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe arọ na oke?

options.a: Arọ anaghị agbanwe, ma oke na-abawanye
options.b: Ma arọ ma oke na-ebelata
options.c: Arọ na-abawanye, ma oke na-ebelata
options.d: Ma arọ ma oke na-abawanye

hints: Ọbụlagodi mmiri jikọtara, ọnụ ọgụgụ niile nke molekul anaghị agbanwe.
Mgbe ice na-etolite, ọ na-etolite nhazi hexagon nwere oghere ukwu.
chemistry-e4-q2.explanation: Mgbe mmiri na-aghọ ice, a na-echekwa oke (arọ), ma n'ihi na molekul mmiri na-etolite kristal hexagon nwere oghere ọtụtụ site na njikọ hydrogen, oke na-abawanye ihe dị ka 10%.

chemistry-e4-q3.prompt: Gịnị bụ isi ihe sayensị kpatara 'mgbawa mmiri n'ọkpọkọ' (burst pipes) nke na-eme n'oge oyi nke ọnụọgụ ala efu na-eme ka ọkpọkọ mmiri dị n'èzí gbawaa?

options.a: N'ihi na mmiri dị n'ime ọkpọkọ na-ejikọta ma oke ya na-agbasa, na-ahụ ihe mgbidi ọkpọkọ ike
options.b: N'ihi na oyi na-eme ka ọkpọkọ igwe daa ma gbazee
options.c: N'ihi na nrụgide mmiri na-abawanye ọ bụ ugboro 10 n'oge oyi
options.d: N'ihi na ice na-emepụta ọkụ eletrik ma na-ere ọkpọkọ

hints: Chee echiche otu oke mmiri si agbanwe mgbe ọ na-aghọ ice.
Mgbe mmiri jikọtara, oke ya na-abawanye.
chemistry-e4-q3.explanation: Mmiri nwere àgwà pụrụ iche nke ịgbasa oke mgbe ọ na-ejikọta, ya mere mgbe mmiri dị n'ime ọkpọkọ jupụtara na-ejikọta, nrụgide mgbasa na-emebi ọkpọkọ igwe siri ike, na-akpata mgbawa.

chemistry-e4-q4.prompt: Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere ọdịiche dị n'etiti 'evaporation' na 'ịsị (boiling)' mgbe a na-ekpo mmiri n'ime ite?

options.a: Evaporation na-eme naanị n'elu mmiri, ma ịsị na-eme n'ebe nsị (100℃) site na ọkpụkpụ ikuku na-etolite n'elu na n'ime mmiri niile
options.b: Evaporation na-eme naanị na 100℃, ma ịsị na-eme n'okpomọkụ niile
options.c: Evaporation bụ mgbe mmiri na-aghọ ice, ma ịsị bụ mgbe ọ na-aghọ ikuku mmiri
options.d: Evaporation na ịsị bụ otu ihe ahụ kpamkpam

hints: Ịkpọ nkụ uwe bụ evaporation na-eme nwayọ n'elu ọbụlagodi n'okpomọkụ dị ala.
Mmiri na-asị nke ọma na 100 bụ ịsị, ebe ọkpụkpụ na-agbawa n'ime.
chemistry-e4-q4.explanation: Evaporation bụ mgbe molekul dị n'elu mmiri na-aghọ gas ọbụlagodi n'okpomọkụ dị n'okpuru ebe nsị, ma ịsị bụ mgbe a rutere ebe nsị ma mmiri na-aghọ gas nke ọma n'elu na n'ime niile.

chemistry-e4-c.prompt: [Mgbanwe ọnọdụ miri emi] E tinyere mmiri n'ime beaker ma kpoo ya ruo mgbe ọ malitere ịsị nke ọma. Ọbụlagodi mgbe e mere ka ọkụ dị ike karịa ma na-aga n'ihu na-ekpo ọkụ, akara thermometer anaghị arị elu karịa 100℃. Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara nke a?

options.a: N'ihi na ike okpomọkụ e nyere niile na-eji maka mgbanwe ọnọdụ mmiri ka ọ bụrụ ikuku mmiri (okpomọkụ vaporization), ọ bụghị iji bulie okpomọkụ mmiri
options.b: N'ihi na thermometer na-emebi n'elu 100 degrees
options.c: N'ihi na mmiri enweghịzi ike iwere okpomọkụ
options.d: N'ihi na ikuku mmiri na-eme ka thermometer dị jụụ

hints: N'oge ọnọdụ ihe na-agbanwe, okpomọkụ nke ihe na-anọgide n'otu.
A na-akpọ nke a 'latent heat (okpomọkụ zoro ezo, okpomọkụ vaporization)'.
chemistry-e4-c.explanation: Mgbe mmiri doro anya na-asị, ike okpomọkụ e nyere niile na-eji agbaji ịdọta n'etiti molekul wee gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ gas (okpomọkụ vaporization), ya mere okpomọkụ na-anọgide n'otu ruo mgbe mmiri niile ghọrọ ikuku mmiri.

chemistry-e4-q5.prompt: Kedu nke jikọtara usoro mgbanwe ọnọdụ nke 'igirigi (dew)' na-ewu n'akwụkwọ osisi n'ụtụtụ na 'frost' na-acha ọcha n'elu windo ma ọ bụ ụlọ n'abalị ngwụsị oge okpomọkụ ziri ezi?

options.a: igirigi: ikuku mmiri na-aghọ mmiri mmiri (liquefaction) / frost: ikuku mmiri na-aghọ kristal ice ozugbo (sublimation)
options.b: igirigi: ice na-agbaze (melting) / frost: mmiri na-asị (vaporization)
options.c: Ma igirigi ma frost bụ mmiri evaporated ka ọ bụrụ ikuku mmiri
options.d: igirigi: mmiri iyi si n'ala pụta / frost: snow si n'eluigwe daa

hints: Igirigi bụ mmiri mmiri (ikuku mmiri → mmiri).
Frost bụ kristal ice e mere n'okpomọkụ dị n'okpuru efu (ikuku mmiri → ihe siri ike).
chemistry-e4-q5.explanation: Igirigi bụ ikuku mmiri dị n'ikuku nke gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ mmiri (condensation) n'elu akwụkwọ osisi jụrụ oyi n'abalị, ma frost bụ ikuku mmiri nke gbanwere ozugbo ka ọ bụrụ kristal ice na-agafeghị n'ọnọdụ mmiri n'okpomọkụ dị n'okpuru efu, nke bụ sublimation.

chemistry-e5-q1.prompt: E gbazere gram 50 shuga kpamkpam n'ime gram 200 mmiri. Kedu nke jikọtara 'solvent', 'solute', na 'solution' n'ime mmiri shuga a ziri ezi?

options.a: solvent: mmiri / solute: shuga / solution: mmiri shuga
options.b: solvent: shuga / solute: mmiri / solution: mmiri shuga
options.c: solvent: mmiri shuga / solute: shuga / solution: mmiri
options.d: solvent: mmiri / solute: mmiri shuga / solution: shuga

hints: Mmiri na-agbaze = solvent, ihe na-agbaze = solute, ngwakọta zuru ezu = solution.
Na mmiri shuga, shuga na-agbaze bụ solute, mmiri na-agbaze bụ solvent.
chemistry-e5-q1.explanation: Mmiri nke na-agbaze bụ 'solvent', shuga nke na-agbaze bụ 'solute', ma ngwakọta doro anya ebe ha abụọ jikọtara nke ọma bụ 'solution'.

chemistry-e5-q2.prompt: A chọrọ ịmụ àgwà nke ngwọta mmiri nnu dị n'ime beaker. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere àgwà nke ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị)?

options.a: Ọ bụrụ na e wepụta ma ọ bụ nụrụ ụtọ si n'elu, n'etiti, ma ọ bụ n'ala ngwọta, ụtọ nnu (nchịkọta) bụ otu kpamkpam
options.b: Mgbe oge gafere, nnu na-adị arọ ma na-ada n'ala n'onwe ya
options.c: Ọ bụrụ na a lee ya na ugogbe anya na-ekpo, a na-ahụ ụmụ nnu ka ha na-efe n'ime mmiri
options.d: Ọ bụrụ na a zacha ya na akwụkwọ nzacha, nnu niile na-anọgide n'elu akwụkwọ nzacha

hints: Ngwọta bụ 'ngwakọta otu ụdị' ebe ụmụ ya jikọtara n'ọkwa molekul.
Ọ naghị ada n'ala ọbụlagodi ogologo oge.
chemistry-e5-q2.explanation: Ezigbo ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị) nwere ụmụ solute ndị gbasasịrị n'otu n'etiti molekul solvent, ya mere ọ naghị ada n'ala ọbụlagodi ogologo oge, ma nchịkọta ya dị otu n'ebe ọ bụla.

chemistry-e5-q3.prompt: Mgbe a na-etinye nnu n'ime gram 100 mmiri, gịnị mere nnu ji agbaze karịa mgbe mmiri dị 60℃ karịa mgbe ọ dị 20℃?

options.a: N'ihi na ka okpomọkụ dị elu, mmegharị ọkụ nke molekul solvent na-aga n'ihu, ya mere solubility (ike iwere solute) na-abawanye
options.b: N'ihi na okpomọkụ dị elu na-ebibi nhazi molekul nnu
options.c: N'ihi na mmiri ọkụ na-akpọpụ nnu
options.d: N'ihi na nnu na-hụ mmiri oyi n'anya

hints: Cheta curve mgbanwe solubility na okpomọkụ.
Ka ọ na-ekpo ọkụ, mmegharị molekul na-aga n'ihu.
chemistry-e5-q3.explanation: Maka ọtụtụ solute siri ike, ka okpomọkụ na-abawanye, mmegharị nke ụmụ solvent na-aga n'ihu, ma site na ọnọdụ enthalpy nke mgbaze, solubility (ọnụọgụ kachasị nke nwere ike igbaze n'otu ọnụọgụ solvent) na-abawanye.

chemistry-e5-q4.prompt: E tinyere tomato nta n'ime tanki nwere mmiri doro anya, ọ dara n'ala. Mgbe e tinyere nnu ọtụtụ n'ime tanki ma kpoo ya, tomato nta ahụ gbagoro n'elu mmiri. Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara nke a?

options.a: N'ihi na nnu gbazere ma oke ngwọta mmiri nnu karịrị oke tomato nta
options.b: N'ihi na nnu na-awụ tomato nta ka ọ dị mfe
options.c: N'ihi na tomato nta na-ajụ oyi wee na-ekwupụta ikuku
options.d: N'ihi na mmiri nnu na-ebuga ọkụ eletrik

hints: Ọ bụrụ na oke mmiri karịrị oke ihe, ihe ahụ na-efe.
Ka nnu na-agbaze ọtụtụ, arọ (oke) mmiri na-abawanye.
chemistry-e5-q4.explanation: Mmiri nnu nwere oke karịa mmiri doro anya, ma mgbe nnu na-agbaze n'ihu ma oke mmiri nnu karịrị oke nkezi nke tomato nta, ike buoyancy na-abụ ihe karịrị ike gravity, ya mere ọ na-efe n'elu.

chemistry-e5-c.prompt: [Crystallization miri emi] E mere ngwọta saturated site n'ịgbaze alum n'ime mmiri ọkụ 60℃ ruo mgbe ọ gbazeghị ọzọ, wee kwụọ eri silk n'ime ya ma hapụ ya ka ọ dị jụụ nwayọ n'okpomọkụ ụlọ, kristal alum mara mma dị ka nkume dị oke ọnụ tolitere n'eri silk. Gịnị bụ ụkpụrụ nke ihe a?

options.a: N'ihi na ka okpomọkụ na-ada, solubility nke alum na-ebelata, ma oke nke enweghịzi ike ịgbaze na-ewepụta dị ka kristal siri ike
options.b: N'ihi na ngwọta alum jikọtara ka ọ bụrụ ice
options.c: N'ihi na eri silk mepụtara alum n'ụzọ kemịkal
options.d: N'ihi na uzuzu dị n'ikuku gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ alum

hints: Gịnị na-eme ihe siri ike nke gbazere ọtụtụ mgbe ọ na-ekpo ọkụ mgbe ọ na-ajụ oyi?
Mgbe okpomọkụ na-ada ma solubility na-adị obere, ọ na-apụta (precipitation).
chemistry-e5-c.explanation: Mgbe okpomọkụ na-ada, solubility nke ihe siri ike na-ebelata ngwa ngwa, ma solute supersaturated nke gbazere karịa solubility ọhụrụ na-ejikọta, na-etolite kristal n'usoro ma na-apụta, nke a bụ 'recrystallization (precipitation)'.

chemistry-e5-q5.prompt: Mgbe a na-emeghe kan ihe ọṅụṅụ carbonated oyi (sprite, cola), gịnị bụ ụkpụrụ sayensị nke 'tsss' na ọkpụkpụ ikuku na-ebili nke ọma n'ihe ọṅụṅụ ahụ?

options.a: Mgbe e meghere kan, nrụgide dị n'ime na-ada ruo nrụgide ikuku, solubility nke carbon dioxide gas na-ebelata ngwa ngwa
options.b: Mgbe e meghere kan, okpomọkụ nke ihe ọṅụṅụ na-ada n'okpuru efu ọsọ ọsọ
options.c: Mmiri dị n'ihe ọṅụṅụ na-esi ngwa ngwa
options.d: Oxygen dị n'ikuku na-abanye n'ime ihe ọṅụṅụ

hints: Chee echiche banyere iwu Henry (Henry's law).
Solubility nke gas na-abawanye mgbe nrụgide dị elu, ma na-ebelata mgbe nrụgide na-ada.
chemistry-e5-q5.explanation: Carbon dioxide gas nke gbazere ọtụtụ n'ime mmiri n'ihi nrụgide dị elu n'ime kan mechiri emechi, mgbe e meghere ya ma nrụgide ada, solubility na-ebelata dịka iwu Henry si dị, ma ọ na-apụta dị ka ọkpụkpụ ikuku.

chemistry-e6-q1.prompt: Mgbe e wụsara ngwọta dị iche iche n'ime red cabbage indicator, ngwọta A gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ uhie, ma ngwọta B gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ wee bụrụ odo odo. Kedu àgwà nke ngwọta abụọ ahụ ziri ezi?

options.a: Ngwọta A bụ acid, ngwọta B bụ base
options.b: Ngwọta A bụ base, ngwọta B bụ acid
options.c: Ma ngwọta A ma B bụ neutral
options.d: Ngwọta A bụ neutral, ngwọta B bụ acid

hints: Mmiri ahụ red cabbage, nke bụ indicator okike, nwere pigment anthocyanin.
N'acid, ọ na-agbanwe n'uhie; n'ime base, ọ na-agbanwe n'acha anụnụ anụnụ ruo odo odo.
chemistry-e6-q1.explanation: Red cabbage indicator na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ uhie n'acid, ma ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ, akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, na odo odo n'ime base.

chemistry-e6-q2.prompt: Mgbe e wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) n'ime akpị akwa ma ọ bụ marble (nke nwere calcium carbonate), ọkpụkpụ ikuku pụtara. Gịnị na-eme mgbe e kpọkọtara gas a ma gafere ya n'ime mmiri lime?

options.a: Mmiri lime na-adị ọcha ọcha (nke na-egosi carbon dioxide gas)
options.b: Ọ bụrụ na e kpọtụrụ mmiri lime ọkụ, ọ na-agba ọkụ na ụda nnukwu
options.c: Agba mmiri lime na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ
options.d: Ọ dịghị mgbanwe ọ bụla na-eme

hints: Mgbe carbonate na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide (CO₂) gas.
Mgbe a na-agafe carbon dioxide n'ime mmiri lime, a na-emepụta precipitate calcium carbonate na-eme ka ọ dị ọcha ọcha.
chemistry-e6-q2.explanation: Mgbe calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) gas, ma carbon dioxide na-eme ihe na mmiri lime ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) iji mepụta precipitate calcium carbonate na-acha ọcha, na-eme ka ọ dị ọcha ọcha.

chemistry-e6-q3.prompt: Gịnị bụ ụkpụrụ sayensị nke amamihe a na-eji n'ebe a na-esi nri ịwụsa ihe lemon ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) iji wepụ ísì azụ (trimethylamine na-enwe àgwà base, wdg) mgbe a na-esi nri azụ?

options.a: Ihe acid (ihe lemon) na-ezute ihe ísì azụ nwere àgwà base ma na-eme neutralization
options.b: Ihe lemon na-eme ka anụ azụ dị oyi ma jikọta ya
options.c: Mmanya na-agbaze calcium n'ọkpụkpụ azụ ma wepụ ya
options.d: Agba odo nke lemon na-ekpuchi ísì

hints: Mgbe acid na base zutere, ha na-efunahụ àgwà ibe ha site na 'neutralization reaction'.
Ihe ísì azụ bụ base.
chemistry-e6-q3.explanation: Ihe kpatara ísì azụ, ìgwè amine, nwere àgwà base, ya mere mgbe a wụsara ihe acid dịka ihe lemon (citric acid) ma ọ bụ mmanya (acetic acid), acid-base neutralization na-eme ma ísì azụ na-apụ.

chemistry-e6-q4.prompt: Mgbe a na-emenyụ ọkụ n'ebe ndụ ọhịa (camping) ka e mesịrị ọkụ ọgbụ, ịkpuchi ya na ala ma ọ bụ aja ma ọ bụ ịgba ihe nmenyụ ọkụ bụ ụzọ nmenyụ ọkụ nke na-egbochi kedu n'ime 'ihe atọ nke ọkụ'?

options.a: Igbochi nnyefe nke oxygen n'ikuku (smothering)
options.b: Iwepụ ihe na-agba ọkụ (osisi) n'onwe ya kpamkpam
options.c: Ibuli okpomọkụ n'elu ebe ọkụ na-amalite
options.d: Iwere carbon dioxide dị n'agbata

hints: Ihe atọ nke ọkụ: ihe na-agba ọkụ, oxygen, okpomọkụ n'elu ebe ọkụ na-amalite
Ọ bụrụ na e kpuchie ya na aja, ikuku agaghị agafe n'ọkụ.
chemistry-e6-q4.explanation: Ịkpuchi ọkụ na aja ma ọ bụ blanket n'ime ma ọ bụ ịgba ihe nmenyụ ọkụ carbon dioxide bụ ụzọ 'smothering', nke na-egbochi oxygen ịbanye ka e menyụọ ọkụ.

chemistry-e6-c.prompt: [Ntụgharị mmeghachi omume miri emi] E wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala n'obere n'obere site na dropper n'ime sodium hydroxide solution nke na-agbanwe ọcha ọcha litmus akwụkwọ ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ. Mgbe e tinyere hydrochloric acid zuru ezu, kedu mgbanwe na-eme n'ime ngwakọta ziri ezi?

options.a: Ọkụ na-apụta ma okpomọkụ na-arị elu, ma ngwọta ikpeazụ na-agbanwe akwụkwọ litmus acha anụnụ anụnụ ka ọ bụrụ uhie
options.b: Ngwọta na-adị oyi ngwa ngwa ma ghọọ ice
options.c: Ọ dịghị mmeghachi omume ọ bụla na-eme, ọ na-anọgide dịka mbụ
options.d: Naanị hydrogen gas na-apụta na mgbawa

hints: Na neutralization reaction, a na-emepụta neutralization heat ma okpomọkụ na-arị elu.
Ọ bụrụ na hydrochloric acid karịrị ókè, ngwọta ga-abụ acid.
chemistry-e6-c.explanation: Mgbe acid (hydrochloric acid) na base (sodium hydroxide) na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta mmiri na nnu, a na-ewepụta neutralization heat ma okpomọkụ na-arị elu. Ọ bụrụ na e tinye hydrochloric acid karịrị ókè, ngwọta niile na-abụ acid ma na-agbanwe akwụkwọ litmus acha anụnụ anụnụ ka ọ bụrụ uhie.

chemistry-e6-q5.prompt: Mgbe nnukwu ọkụ ọhịa na-agbasa, ịrụ 'firebreak' site n'ịgbapụ osisi ndị dị n'ihu ụzọ ọkụ ọhịa na-aga n'ọtụtụ ebe na mbụ site na igwe ọkpụ osisi bụ iwepụ kedu n'ime ihe atọ nke ọkụ?

options.a: Iwepụ ihe na-agba ọkụ (fuel)
options.b: Igbochi oxygen
options.c: Ibelata okpomọkụ n'okpuru ebe ọkụ na-amalite
options.d: Inye carbon dioxide

hints: Ka ọkụ na-agbaba, ihe na-agba ọkụ ga-adịrị n'usoro.
Ọ bụrụ na e wepụ osisi na mbụ, ọkụ enweghị ebe ọzọ ọ ga-agbaba.
chemistry-e6-q5.explanation: Nke a bụ ụkpụrụ nmenyụ ọkụ site n'iwepụ, nke na-egbochi mgbasa ọkụ ọhịa site n'iwepụ 'ihe na-agba ọkụ', otu n'ime ihe dị mkpa nke ọkụ, na mbụ n'ụzọ ọkụ na-aga.

chemistry-m1-q1.prompt: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara 'nrụgide gas' a na-enwe n'akụkụ mgbidi nke akpa mechiri emechi nwere gas?

options.a: N'ihi na ọtụtụ ụmụ gas na-eme mmegharị n'onwe ha ugboro ugboro na-agba mgbidi akpa
options.b: N'ihi na ụmụ gas na-adaba n'ala naanị site na ike ọdọ ụwa
options.c: N'ihi na ụmụ gas na-adọta ibe ha site na electrostatic
options.d: N'ihi na ụmụ gas na-agbalị ịgbaze mgbidi akpa

hints: Molekul gas na-efe n'ọsọ ọsọ dị ukwuu.
Ọnụọgụ na ike nke ịkụ mgbidi na-emepụta nrụgide.
chemistry-m1-q1.explanation: Nrụgide gas na-apụta site n'ike n'otu mpaghara nke ụmụ gas na-agba mgbidi n'ime akpa ahụ mgbe ha na-eme mmegharị n'efu n'agaghị kwụsị.

chemistry-m1-q2.prompt: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?

options.a: 20 mL
options.b: 180 mL
options.c: 30 mL
options.d: 120 mL

hints: Iwu Boyle: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂
1 atm × 60 mL = 3 atm × (?) mL
chemistry-m1-q2.explanation: Dịka iwu Boyle, mgbe okpomọkụ dị otu, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ na-adị. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.

chemistry-m1-q3.prompt: Mgbe e buliri akpa nri e ji eri n'elu ugwu dị elu, akpa ahụ gbara ọkụ nke ukwuu dị ka ọ ga-agbawa. Kedu nkọwa gbasara mmekọrịta nrụgide na oke gas na-akọwa ihe kpatara nke a?

options.a: N'ihi na ka a na-arịgo n'elu ugwu, nrụgide ikuku (nrụgide mpụga) na-ada, ya mere oke gas dị n'ime akpa gbasaa
options.b: N'ihi na okpomọkụ dị n'elu ugwu dị elu nke ukwuu ma gas gbasaa
options.c: N'ihi na nri dị n'ime akpa evaporated
options.d: N'ihi na oxygen dị n'elu ugwu banyere n'ime akpa

hints: Mgbe elu na-abawanye, ikuku na-adị ntakịrị ma nrụgide ikuku na-ebelata.
Mgbe nrụgide mpụga na-adị ntakịrị, oke gas na-abawanye (iwu Boyle).
chemistry-m1-q3.explanation: Mgbe elu na-abawanye, nrụgide ikuku na-ada. Ebe nrụgide gas dị n'ime akpa karịrị nrụgide ikuku mpụga, oke gas dị n'ime na-agbasa ruo mgbe nrụgide n'ime na mpụga ruru otu.

chemistry-m1-q4.prompt: E tinyere bọọlụ ping-pong e gbagbuo n'ime mmiri ọkụ, ma bọọlụ ahụ gbasaa ọzọ ka ọ bụrụ gburugburu ma tọgbọ chakoo. Kedu nkọwa sitere na iwu Charles na ụdị ụmụ gas ziri ezi?

options.a: N'ihi na okpomọkụ ruru elu, mmegharị nke ụmụ gas dị n'ime bọọlụ na-aga n'ihu, ọnụ ọgụgụ na ike nke ịkụ na-abawanye, ma oke gbasaa
options.b: N'ihi na plastik nke bọọlụ riri mmiri ma na-adị oke
options.c: N'ihi na mmiri ọkụ banyere n'ime bọọlụ ma jupụta ya
options.d: N'ihi na okpomọkụ rịrị elu ma ọnụọgụ molekul gas dị n'ime bọọlụ rịrị okpukpu abụọ

hints: Iwu Charles: mgbe nrụgide dị otu, ọ bụrụ na okpomọkụ ruru elu, oke gas na-agbasa.
Mgbe okpomọkụ na-arị elu, ọsọ nkezi nke ụmụ gas na-abawanye.
chemistry-m1-q4.explanation: Dịka iwu Charles si dị, mgbe okpomọkụ na-arị elu, ike mmegharị nkezi nke molekul gas na-abawanye, ịkụ mgbidi n'ime na-aghọ ihe siri ike, ya mere nrụgide dị n'ime na-abawanye ma bọọlụ e gbagbuo na-agbasa.

chemistry-m1-c.prompt: [Ọsọ mgbasa miri emi] E tinyere owu a gbanyere na ammonia mmiri siri ike (molecular mass 17) na owu a gbanyere na hydrochloric acid siri ike (molecular mass 36.5) n'otu oge n'ọnụ abụọ nke ogologo ọkpọkọ gilaasị ma kpuchie ha na rọba. Nwa oge ka e mesịrị, mgbe eriri anwụrụ ọcha (ammonium chloride) pụtara n'ime ọkpọkọ, kedu ebe ọ dị nso?

options.a: Ebe ọ dị nso karịa n'ebe owu hydrochloric acid dị
options.b: Ebe ọ dị nso karịa n'ebe owu ammonia mmiri dị
options.c: N'etiti ogologo ọkpọkọ kpọmkwem
options.d: N'èzí ọkpọkọ n'ime ikuku

hints: Ka molekul gas dị mfe, ọsọ mgbasa ya na-adị ngwa (iwu mgbasa Graham).
Ammonia (17) dị mfe nke ukwuu karịa hydrogen chloride (36.5).
chemistry-m1-c.explanation: Ọsọ mgbasa nke gas bụ inverse nke square root nke molecular mass. Ammonia gas dị mfe (molecular mass 17) na-aga ngwa ngwa karịa hydrogen chloride gas dị arọ (36.5), ya mere ha na-emeghachi omume n'ebe ọ dị nso karịa owu hydrochloric acid, nke na-aga nwayọ, ma eriri anwụrụ ọcha na-apụta.

chemistry-m1-q5.prompt: E tinyere bọọlụ rọba jupụtara n'ikuku n'ime nitrogen mmiri nke dị -196℃, ma bọọlụ ahụ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ furu oke ya ma kpọọ nkụ. Kedu ihe kpatara nke a ziri ezi?

options.a: N'oké oyi, ike mmegharị nke ụmụ gas dị n'ime bọọlụ na-ada nke ukwuu, ma ebe dị n'etiti molekul na-abụ obere
options.b: N'ihi na rọba bọọlụ hapụrụ gas niile gafere
options.c: N'ihi na ikuku dị n'ime bọọlụ niile mebiri emebi ma ọ pụọ
options.d: N'ihi na nitrogen mmiri ahụ ghichara bọọlụ

hints: Iwu Charles: oke gas na-edozi ya na okpomọkụ zuru oke.
Mgbe okpomọkụ dị ala nke ukwuu, mmegharị molekul gas na-adị nwayọ dịka a ga-asị na ọ kwụsịrị.
chemistry-m1-q5.explanation: Dịka iwu Charles si dị, mgbe a jụrụ oyi ngwa ngwa ruo $-196^\circ\text{C}$, mmegharị ọkụ nke molekul gas na-adị nwayọ nke ukwuu ma akụkụ ụfọdụ na-aghọ mmiri, ya mere oke dị n'ime na-ebelata nke ukwuu.

chemistry-m2-q1.prompt: Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara atom, nke nwere nucleus na electron, na-abụ ihe na-anọghị n'akụkụ eletrik (neutral)?

options.a: N'ihi na nnukwu (+) charge nke nucleus na nchikota (-) charge nke electron ndị na-agagharị n'ime gburugburu nucleus bụ otu
options.b: N'ihi na neutron anọghị n'ime nucleus
options.c: N'ihi na electron enweghị charge ọ bụla
options.d: N'ihi na atom dị obere nke ukwuu ma enweghị ike inwe eletrik

hints: Nucleus nwere (+) charge n'ihi proton.
Electron nwere (-) charge.
chemistry-m2-q1.explanation: Atom bụ ihe neutral n'akụkụ eletrik n'ihi na nchikota (+) charge nke proton dị n'etiti nucleus na nchikota (-) charge nke electron ndị na-agagharị n'orbit bụ otu kpamkpam.

chemistry-m2-q2.prompt: Kedu nkọwa banyere nhazi 'ion', ebe atom neutral na-efunahụ ma ọ bụ nweta electron wee nwee charge, ziri ezi?

options.a: Atom metal na-efunahụ electron ma na-aghọ (+) ion ngwa ngwa, ma atom non-metal na-enweta electron ma na-aghọ (-) ion ngwa ngwa
options.b: Proton nke nucleus na-awụpụ n'èzí ma na-aghọ anion
options.c: Mgbe e funahụrụ electron, ọ na-aghọ anion nwere (-) charge
options.d: Ọbụlagodi mgbe ọ ghọrọ ion, ọnụ ọgụgụ electron niile anaghị agbanwe

hints: Sodium (Na) na-efunahụ otu electron ma ghọọ Na⁺.
Chlorine (Cl) na-enweta otu electron ma ghọọ Cl⁻.
chemistry-m2-q2.explanation: Atom na-efunahụ electron nke ọkpụkpụ ọdụ iji bụrụ cation (ọkachasị metal), ma ọ bụ na-enweta electron iji mepụta anion nke na-eso octet rule (ọkachasị non-metal).

chemistry-m2-q3.prompt: Mgbe e tinyere ihe nlele A na B amaghị n'ime ọkụ n'èzí, ihe nlele A gosiri ọkụ ọbara ọbara odo, ma ihe nlele B gosiri ọkụ acha anụnụ anụnụ akwụkwọ ndụ. Kedu metal dị na ihe nlele A na B?

options.a: Ihe nlele A: sodium (Na) / Ihe nlele B: copper (Cu)
options.b: Ihe nlele A: potassium (K) / Ihe nlele B: strontium (Sr)
options.c: Ihe nlele A: copper (Cu) / Ihe nlele B: lithium (Li)
options.d: Ihe nlele A: barium (Ba) / Ihe nlele B: sodium (Na)

hints: Agba ọkụ nke sodium dị n'ime nnu bụ odo odo ọcha.
Copper na-egosi ọkụ pụrụ iche nke acha anụnụ anụnụ akwụkwọ ndụ.
chemistry-m2-q3.explanation: Ihe metal ụfọdụ na-egosi agba ọkụ pụrụ iche. Sodium ($\text{Na}$) na-egosi ọkụ odo, copper ($\text{Cu}$) na-egosi ọkụ acha anụnụ anụnụ akwụkwọ ndụ.

chemistry-m2-q4.prompt: Kedu reagent a ga-awụsa iji nyochaa ma chloride ion (Cl⁻) nke fọdụrụ dịka ihe sitere na ịkwụsị ọrịa dị n'ime mmiri ọkpọkọ, na kedu formula nke precipitate ọcha e mepụtara?

options.a: silver nitrate (AgNO₃) solution — silver chloride (AgCl)
options.b: sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution — silver hydroxide (AgOH)
options.c: barium chloride (BaCl₂) solution — barium sulfate (BaSO₄)
options.d: phenolphthalein solution — silver carbonate (Ag₂CO₃)

hints: Mgbe silver ion (Ag⁺) na chloride ion (Cl⁻) zutere, a na-emepụta precipitate ọcha na-agbaghị agbaze n'ime mmiri.
Nha precipitate: Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ → AgCl↓
chemistry-m2-q4.explanation: Mgbe silver ion ($\text{Ag}^+$) nke silver nitrate solution na chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) dị n'ime mmiri na-emeghachi omume, a na-emepụta precipitate ọcha silver chloride ($\text{AgCl}$) nke na-agaghị agbaze n'ime mmiri, ya mere a pụrụ ịchọpụta chloride ion.

chemistry-m2-c.prompt: [Nyocha ion miri emi] A chọrọ ịlele ma lead ion (Pb²⁺) dị n'ime mmiri mkpofu nke ụlọ ọrụ. Kedu agba na formula nke precipitate nke na-apụta mgbe e wụsara potassium iodide (KI) solution ziri ezi?

options.a: precipitate odo — lead iodide (PbI₂)
options.b: precipitate ojii — lead oxide (PbO)
options.c: precipitate ọcha — lead chloride (PbCl₂)
options.d: precipitate acha anụnụ anụnụ — lead nitrate (Pb(NO₃)₂)

hints: Mgbe lead ion na iodide ion zutere, a na-emepụta precipitate odo doro anya.
Pb²⁺ + 2I⁻ → PbI₂↓
chemistry-m2-c.explanation: Mgbe lead ion ($\text{Pb}^{2+}$) na iodide ion ($\text{I}^-$) na-emeghachi omume, a na-emepụta precipitate odo doro anya pụrụ iche, lead iodide ($\text{PbI}_2$).

chemistry-m2-q5.prompt: Mgbe a na-eme electrolysis nke mmiri tinyere obere electrolyte, kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma ụdị gas na-apụta na electrode (-) na (+) yana ọnụọgụ olu ha?

options.a: electrode (-): hydrogen (H₂),  electrode (+): oxygen (O₂),  ọnụọgụ olu = 2 : 1
options.b: electrode (-): oxygen (O₂),  electrode (+): hydrogen (H₂),  ọnụọgụ olu = 1 : 2
options.c: electrode (-): hydrogen (H₂),  electrode (+): chlorine (Cl₂),  ọnụọgụ olu = 1 : 1
options.d: electrode (-): uzuoku mmiri,  electrode (+): nitrogen,  ọnụọgụ olu = 2 : 1

hints: Usoro kemịkalụ nke mmiri bụ H₂O (atọm hydrogen abụọ na atọm oxygen otu).
Ahịrịokwu electrolysis: 2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂
chemistry-m2-q5.explanation: Dịka ahịrịokwu electrolysis nke mmiri $2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g)$ si dị, hydrogen gas na-apụta n'electrode (-) ebe reduction na-eme n'olu $2$, ma oxygen gas na-apụta n'electrode (+) ebe oxidation na-eme n'olu $1$.

chemistry-m3-q1.prompt: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara iwu nchekwa nke oke ji eme mgbe mgbanwe kemịkalụ na-eme?

options.a: N'ihi na ụdị na ọnụọgụ atọm ndị mejupụtara ihe adịghị agbanwe mgbe ọ bụla tupu na mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị
options.b: N'ihi na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ molecule na-adị otu mgbe niile
options.c: N'ihi na atọm ọhụrụ na-apụta n'onwe ha
options.d: N'ihi na okpomọkụ anaghị apụta mgbe mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ na-eme

hints: Cheta iwu nchekwa nke oke nke Lavoisier.
A na-edozigharị atọm naanị, a naghị emepụta ma ọ bụ mebie ha.
chemistry-m3-q1.explanation: Mgbe mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ na-eme, ụzọ atọm si ejikọta na-agbanwe ka ihe ọhụrụ pụta, mana ụdị na ọnụọgụ atọm adịghị apụta ma ọ bụ furu efu, a na-echekwa ha, ya mere ngụkọta oke adịghị agbanwe.

chemistry-m3-q2.prompt: Etinyere ntụ ọla kọpa n'ime crucible ma kpoo ya n'ikuku iji mepụta copper(II) oxide. Mgbe 4 g nke ọla kọpa meghachiri nke ọma, a mepụtara 5 g nke copper(II) oxide. Kedu oke oxygen jikọtara na oke ọla kọpa na oxygen?

options.a: oxygen 1 g,  ọla kọpa : oxygen = 4 : 1
options.b: oxygen 2 g,  ọla kọpa : oxygen = 2 : 1
options.c: oxygen 5 g,  ọla kọpa : oxygen = 4 : 5
options.d: oxygen 0.5 g,  ọla kọpa : oxygen = 8 : 1

hints: Iwu nchekwa nke oke: (ọla kọpa 4 g) + (oxygen ? g) = copper oxide 5 g
Iwu nke ọnụọgụ edoro: dị mfe oke ọla kọpa na oxygen.
chemistry-m3-q2.explanation: Oke oxygen meghachiri bụ $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Dịka iwu nke ọnụọgụ edoro si dị, oke ọla kọpa na oxygen n'ime copper(II) oxide bụ mgbe niile $4 : 1$.

chemistry-m3-q3.prompt: Mgbe okpomọkụ na nrụgide bụ otu, hydrogen gas na oxygen gas na-emeghachi omume ka ha mepụta uzuoku mmiri. Kedu 'ọnụọgụ olu' ziri ezi nke hydrogen, oxygen na uzuoku mmiri a mepụtara? (Iwu nke mmeghachi omume gas)

options.a: hydrogen : oxygen : uzuoku mmiri = 2 : 1 : 2
options.b: hydrogen : oxygen : uzuoku mmiri = 1 : 1 : 1
options.c: hydrogen : oxygen : uzuoku mmiri = 2 : 1 : 3
options.d: hydrogen : oxygen : uzuoku mmiri = 1 : 2 : 2

hints: Ahịrịokwu kemịkalụ: 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2H₂O(g)
Dịka iwu Avogadro si dị, ọnụọgụ coefficient nke gas = ọnụọgụ mole = ọnụọgụ olu.
chemistry-m3-q3.explanation: N'ahịrịokwu kemịkalụ $2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2\text{O}(g)$, n'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide, ọnụọgụ coefficient nke gas bụ ọnụọgụ nke molecule yana ọnụọgụ olu, ya mere ọ bụ $2 : 1 : 2$.

chemistry-m3-q4.prompt: Kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma mgbanwe ume n'ime ihe nkpo okpomọkụ nke a na-ama jijiji n'oge oyi (mmeghachi omume oxidation nke ntụ ígwè) na ihe nkpo oyi a na-eji agwọ mgbu ukwu nke nta nke nta (mmeghachi omume nke ammonium nitrate na mmiri)?

options.a: ihe nkpo okpomọkụ: mmeghachi omume exothermic na-ahapụ okpomọkụ / ihe nkpo oyi: mmeghachi omume endothermic na-ewere okpomọkụ
options.b: ihe nkpo okpomọkụ: mmeghachi omume endothermic na-ewere okpomọkụ / ihe nkpo oyi: mmeghachi omume exothermic na-ahapụ okpomọkụ
options.c: ihe nkpo okpomọkụ na ihe nkpo oyi abụọ bụ mmeghachi omume exothermic
options.d: ihe nkpo okpomọkụ na ihe nkpo oyi abụọ enweghị mbata ma ọ bụ mpụta ume

hints: Ihe nkpo okpomọkụ na-eme ka gburugburu dị ọkụ, ya mere ọ na-ahapụ okpomọkụ (exothermic).
Ihe nkpo oyi na-ewere okpomọkụ gburugburu ma mee ka ọ dị jụụ, ya mere ọ na-ewere okpomọkụ (endothermic).
chemistry-m3-q4.explanation: Mmeghachi omume oxidation nke ígwè bụ mmeghachi omume exothermic na-ahapụ ume okpomọkụ gaa gburugburu ma welie okpomọkụ, ebe mgbaze nke ammonium nitrate bụ mmeghachi omume endothermic na-ewere ume okpomọkụ gburugburu ma wedata okpomọkụ.

chemistry-m3-c.prompt: [Coefficient mmeghachi omume dị elu] Mgbe propane gas (C₃H₈) na-agbaze kpamkpam na oxygen (O₂), a na-emepụta carbon dioxide (CO₂) na mmiri (H₂O). N'ime ahịrịokwu kemịkalụ a hazigharịrị C₃H₈ + a O₂ → b CO₂ + c H₂O, kedu ngụkọta coefficient (a + b + c)?
hints: Ọnụọgụ atọm C: b = 3
Ọnụọgụ atọm H: 2c = 8 → c = 4. Ọnụọgụ atọm O: 2a = 2b + c = 6 + 4 = 10 → a = 5. a + b + c = 5 + 3 + 4 = ?
chemistry-m3-c.explanation: Ahịrịokwu kemịkalụ a hazigharịrị bụ $\text{C}_3\text{H}_8 + 5\text{O}_2 \rightarrow 3\text{CO}_2 + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}$. Ya mere coefficient bụ $a=5, b=3, c=4$, ngụkọta ha bụ $5 + 3 + 4 = 12$.

chemistry-m3-q5.prompt: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na oxygen nke ukwuu n'okpomọkụ ụlọ. Mgbe etinyere obere ntụ black manganese dioxide (MnO₂), ụfụfụ (oxygen gas) pụtara dị ka mgbawa. Kedu ọrụ manganese dioxide?

options.a: 'catalyst' nke na-eme ka ọsọ mmeghachi omume dị ngwa n'ejighị onwe ya meghachi omume ma ọ bụ gwụ
options.b: ihe na-emeghachi omume nke na-ejikọta na hydrogen peroxide ka ọ bụrụ ngwakọta ọhụrụ
options.c: ihe na-ejide oxygen niile a na-emepụta
options.d: oxidizing agent na-eme ka ngwọta bụrụ acidic

hints: Oke na àgwà manganese dioxide adịghị agbanwe ma tupu ma mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị.
Ọ bụ onye enyemaka na-eme ka ọsọ mmeghachi omume dị ngwa.
chemistry-m3-q5.explanation: Manganese dioxide na-arụ ọrụ dị ka positive catalyst nke na-ebelata ume mkpalite (activation energy) n'ime mmeghachi omume mgbaze nke hydrogen peroxide ma na-eme ka ọsọ mmeghachi omume dị oke elu, ebe oke na ngwakọta kemịkalụ ya adịghị agbanwe tupu na mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị.

chemistry-h1-q1.prompt: Kedu nsonaazụ nnwale kacha ziri ezi na-eji tụnyere ike nkwụ ọkụ eletrik nke ihe A (sodium chloride) na ihe B (sugar)?

options.a: A na-anabata ọkụ eletrik n'ọnọdụ ngwọta mmiri, ebe B anaghị anabata ọkụ eletrik n'ọnọdụ siri ike ma ọ bụ ngwọta mmiri
options.b: A na B abụọ na-anabata ọkụ eletrik nke ọma n'ọnọdụ siri ike
options.c: A anaghị anabata ọkụ eletrik n'ime ngwọta mmiri, mana B na-anabata ọkụ eletrik n'ime ngwọta mmiri
options.d: A na B abụọ anaghị anabata ọkụ eletrik ma ọlị n'ime ngwọta mmiri

hints: Ihe jikọtara ionic (NaCl) na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ka ọ bụrụ ions nwere ike ịkwaga n'onwe ha.
Ihe molecule jikọtara covalent (sugar) na-adịgide dị ka molecule ọbụlagodi mgbe ọ gbazere n'ime mmiri, ya mere enweghị ions.
chemistry-h1-q1.explanation: Sodium chloride, ihe jikọtara ionic, na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ma kewaa ka ọ bụrụ cations na anions, ya mere ọkụ eletrik na-aga n'ime ngwọta mmiri, mana sugar, ihe jikọtara covalent, na-agbaze dị ka molecule, enweghị ihe na-ebu ụgwọ eletrik, ya mere ọkụ eletrik anaghị agafe.

chemistry-h1-q2.prompt: Mgbe a na-etinye ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH) nke nta nke nta n'ime hydrochloric acid (HCl) dị n'ọnụọgụ ụfọdụ, kedu nsonaazụ ziri ezi nke ịlele mgbanwe ọnụọgụ ions n'ime ngwọta na okpomọkụ?

options.a: Okpomọkụ na-arị elu ruo mgbe ọ ruru ebe neutralization, ebe a na-edekọ okpomọkụ kasị elu
options.b: Ọnụọgụ hydrogen ions (H⁺) na-abawanye mgbe niile
options.c: Ọnụọgụ sodium ions (Na⁺) na-ebelata mgbe ebe neutralization gasịrị
options.d: Ngụkọta ọnụọgụ chloride ions (Cl⁻), nke bụ spectator ions, na-abawanye mgbe niile

hints: Mgbe mmeghachi omume neutralization (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O) na-eme, a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization.
Okpomọkụ dị elu kachasị n'ebe neutralization ebe H⁺ na OH⁻ na-emeghachi omume kpamkpam.
chemistry-h1-q2.explanation: Ebe a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization n'oge neutralization, okpomọkụ nke ngwọta na-eru n'ebe kachasị elu mgbe ọ ruru ebe neutralization ebe mmeghachi omume zuru ezu. Chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) bụ spectator ion na-anaghị emeghachi omume, ya mere ọnụọgụ ya na-adịgide otu.

chemistry-h1-q3.prompt: Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi nke 'oxidation' na 'reduction' dabere n'ịkwaga eletrọn n'ime kemistrị ọgbara ọhụrụ?

options.a: Oxidation bụ mmeghachi omume nke ịfụ eletrọn, ma reduction bụ mmeghachi omume nke inweta eletrọn

chemistry-h2-q1.prompt: N'ime 11.2 L nke methane gas (CH₄, oke molecule 16) n'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, kedu ọnụọgụ mole nke methane na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ mole nke atọm hydrogen (H)?

options.a: methane 0.5 mol,  atọm hydrogen 2.0 mol
options.b: methane 1.0 mol,  atọm hydrogen 4.0 mol

options.d: methane 2.0 mol,  atọm hydrogen 8.0 mol

hints: N'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L.

Nzọụkwụ 1: (C), ebe CuO anaghị abawanye karịa 10.0 g ọbụlagodi mgbe Cu na-abawanye, bụ ọnọdụ ebe $\mathrm{O_2}$ 2.0 g dị n'arịa meghachiri kpamkpam, ya mere CuO 10.0 g = Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g, ya bụ Cu:O = 4:1 (nyocha: (A) bụ Cu 4.0 g + O 1.0 g = 5.0 g, O fọdụrụ, (B) bụ Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g = 10.0 g, enweghị ọtụtụ ma ọ bụ ntakịrị, ma (C) Cu 4.0 g fọdụrụ).

Nzọụkwụ 3: CuO a mepụtara = 14.0 + 3.5 = 17.5 g (nchekwa oke, oke Cu:O:CuO = 4:1:5).
Ya mere azịza ziri ezi bụ a: CuO 17.5 g a mepụtara, $\mathrm{O_2}$ 0.5 g fọdụrụ. (Azịza ezighi ezi: ngụkọta oke 18.0 g gụnyere O na-emeghachighị omume, 20.0 g gbadoro ụkwụ na O 4.0 g ma leghara anya na ezughị nke Cu)

Nzọụkwụ 3: Mgbe $\mathrm{N_2}$ 0.5 mol meghachiri niile, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 1.5 mol na-eji, ma $\mathrm{NH_3}$ 1.0 mol na-apụta. Oke = 1.0 × 17 = 17 g. $\mathrm{H_2}$ fọdụrụ = 2 − 1.5 = 0.5 mol.
Nzọụkwụ 4: Ngụkọta mole gas mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị = 1.0 + 0.5 = 1.5 mol → olu STP = 1.5 × 22.4 = 33.6 L.

chemistry-killer-04.prompt:
N'ime 25 °C, tinyere HCl(aq) v mL nke amaghị ọnụọgụ ya n'ime $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M 50 mL ma tụọ okpomọkụ kachasị elu nke ngwakọta ngwọta. Okpomọkụ nke ngwọta abụọ tupu e gwakọta ha bụ 20.0 °C abụọ.
Olu HCl v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Okpomọkụ kachasị elu mgbe e gwakọtara (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Nkpuru ngwakọta ngwọta bụ 1.0 g/mL, okpomọkụ pụrụ iche bụ 4.0 J/(g·°C), olu bụ ngụkọta nke ngwọta abụọ ma enweghị mfu okpomọkụ. Mmeghachi omume neutralization bụ $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$. Kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma ọnụọgụ HCl(aq) na okpomọkụ neutralization (okpomọkụ ahapụrụ mgbe 1 mol mmiri pụtara, kJ/mol), n'usoro?

options.a: 1.0 M, 54 kJ/mol
options.b: 2.0 M, 36 kJ/mol
options.c: 2.0 M, 108 kJ/mol
options.d: 2.0 M, 54 kJ/mol

hints: Ebe okpomọkụ dị elu kachasị bụ ebe neutralization kpọmkwem: $M_{\mathrm{HCl}}V_{\mathrm{HCl}} = M_{\mathrm{NaOH}}V_{\mathrm{NaOH}}$. Okpomọkụ ahapụrụ $Q = mc\Delta T$, okpomọkụ neutralization = $Q$ ÷ mole mmiri a mepụtara.
Na v = 25 mL, $M \times 25 = 1.0 \times 50$ → M = 2.0 M. N'oge a, $Q = (75\,\mathrm{g}) \times 4.0 \times (29.0-20.0) = 2700$ J = 2.7 kJ, mmiri 0.050 mol a mepụtara.
chemistry-killer-04.explanation:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Okpomọkụ na-arị elu ka v na-abawanye, ruo n'elu kachasị 29.0 °C na 25 mL, ma mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị ọ na-ada n'ihi na ngwọta na-emeghachighị omume na-abawanye (ngụkọta olu ngwọta na-abawanye). Ya mere na 25 mL, H+ na OH- na-emeghachi omume n'enweghị ịkarị ma ọ bụ ịgbagha.
Nzọụkwụ 2: NaOH 0.050 mol (1.0 M × 0.050 L) na-emeghachi omume na HCl 1:1, ya mere HCl 0.050 mol dị n'ime 25 mL. Ọnụọgụ = 0.050 mol ÷ 0.025 L = 2.0 M.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Okpomọkụ Q = mcΔT = (50+25 mL × 1.0 g/mL) × 4.0 × 9.0 = 75 × 4.0 × 9.0 = 2700 J.
Nzọụkwụ 4: Okpomọkụ neutralization = 2700 J ÷ 0.050 mol = 54000 J/mol = 54 kJ/mol.
Nyocha: Mgbe v = 10 mL, H+ 0.020 mol niile na-emeghachi omume, ΔT = 0.020 × 54000 ÷ (60 × 4.0) = 4.5 → 24.5 °C. Mgbe v = 40 mL, OH- 0.050 mol niile na-emeghachi omume, ΔT = 2700 ÷ (90 × 4.0) = 7.5 → 27.5 °C.
Azịza: 2.0 M, 54 kJ/mol (d). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 36 kJ/mol were oke ngwọta dị ka 50 g, 108 kJ/mol were mmiri a mepụtara dị ka 0.025 mol)

Ngụkọta ions (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20

hints: Net ions ($\mathrm{H^+}$, $\mathrm{OH^-}$) na-eji 1:1 ka ha ghọọ mmiri, ma ọnụọgụ spectator ions ($\mathrm{Na^+}$, $\mathrm{Cl^-}$) adịghị agbanwe. Ọnụọgụ ions = ọnụọgụ × olu (mmol).
HCl 50 mL: $\mathrm{H^+}$ = $\mathrm{Cl^-}$ = 10 mmol. NaOH 150 mL: $\mathrm{Na^+}$ = $\mathrm{OH^-}$ = 15 mmol. $\mathrm{OH^-}$ 15 − 10 = 5 mmol fọdụrụ.
chemistry-killer-05.explanation:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ịkọwa tebụl. 0 mL: H+ 10 + Cl- 10 = 20. 50 mL: H+ 5, Cl- 10, Na+ 5 = 20. 100 mL: Cl- 10, Na+ 10 = 20 (ebe neutralization). Ruo ebe neutralization, Na+ na-anọchi H+ 1:1, ya mere ngụkọta ions na-adịgide.
Nzọụkwụ 2: 150 mL: NaOH na-enye Na+ 15 mmol, OH- 15 mmol. H+ 10 mmol na OH- 10 mmol na-emeghachi omume ma na-eji, ya mere OH- 5 mmol fọdụrụ. Ions = Na+ 15, Cl- 10, OH- 5 → ọnụọgụ 3 : 2 : 1, ngụkọta 30 mmol.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ngụkọta ions tupu a gwakọta = (10 + 10) + (15 + 15) = 50 mmol. Ọnụọgụ = 30/50 = 3/5.
Azịza: 3 : 2 : 1, 3/5 (a). (Azịza ezighi ezi: ịtụ OH- dị ka 15 kama 5 bụ ileghara neutralization anya, 5/3 bụ ọnụọgụ edere n'ụzọ nke ọzọ, 3/4 bụ ịgụ ngụkọta ions tupu a gwakọta dị ka 40 n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi)

chemistry-killer-07.prompt: N'ọnọdụ ọkọlọtọ (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L), olu ngwakọta gas nke methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) na carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) bụ 11.2 L ma oke ya bụ 16.4 g. Oke atọm bụ H=1, C=12, O=16, ma Avogadro's number bụ $N_A$. Kedu ngụkọta ọnụọgụ atọm niile dị n'ime ngwakọta gas a?
hints: Dozie ngụkọta mole $n = V/22.4$ na oke $16x + 44y = 16.4$ (x, y = mole nke $\mathrm{CH_4}$, $\mathrm{CO_2}$) dịka simultaneous equations. Ọnụọgụ atọm = (atọm kwa molecule) × mole × $N_A$.
chemistry-killer-07.explanation:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ngụkọta mole = 11.2 L ÷ 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol → x + y = 0.5.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Oke: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Tinye y = 0.5 − x: 16x + 22 − 44x = 16.4 → 28x = 5.6 → x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ọnụọgụ atọm: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ nwere atọm 5 kwa molecule → 0.2 × 5 = 1.0 mol, $\mathrm{CO_2}$ nwere atọm 3 kwa molecule → 0.3 × 3 = 0.9 mol. Ngụkọta 1.9 mol nke atọm = $1.9\,N_A$.
Azịza: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 1.5 weere na ha niile bụ CO2, 2.5 weere na ha niile bụ CH4, 1.7 gụrụ naanị atọm H anọ nke CH4)

chemistry-killer-08.prompt: Nkpuru nke ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide ($\mathrm{NaOH}$, oke formula 40) 20 % (pasent oke) bụ 1.2 g/mL. A chọrọ ịkwụsị ngwọta a na mmiri iji mepụta 600 mL nke ngwọta mmiri NaOH 0.5 M. Kedu olu (mL) nke ngwọta NaOH 20 % achọrọ? (Oke atọm H=1, O=16, Na=23. Molarity $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$, x bụ pasent oke, d bụ nkpuru ngwọta g/mL)

options.a: 60 mL
options.b: 5.0 mL
options.c: 72 mL
options.d: 50 mL

hints: Jiri molarity $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$ chọpụta molarity nke ngwọta 20 %, ma jiri eziokwu na ọnụọgụ mole nke solute dị otu tupu na mgbe ịkwụsị ($M_1V_1 = M_2V_2$).
chemistry-killer-08.explanation:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Molarity nke NaOH 20 % $M = \frac{10 \times 20 \times 1.2}{40} = 6.0$ mol/L (n'ime 1 L = 1200 g ngwọta, NaOH 240 g = 6 mol).
Nzọụkwụ 2: Mole solute nke ngwọta a chọrọ ime = 0.5 mol/L × 0.600 L = 0.30 mol (NaOH 12 g).
Nzọụkwụ 3: Mole solute na-adịgide n'ịkwụsị: 6.0 × V = 0.30 → V = 0.050 L = 50 mL. (Nyocha: 12 g ÷ 0.20 = 60 g ngwọta, 60 g ÷ 1.2 g/mL = 50 mL)
Azịza: 50 mL (d). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 60 mL leghaara nkpuru anya ma tụọ M = 5.0, 72 mL mụbara 60 g site na nkpuru, 5.0 mL bụ njehie nke ebe decimal)

chemistry-killer-09.prompt: N'ime mmeghachi omume $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$, ebe gas A na B na-emeghachi omume ka ha mepụta gas C n'okpomọkụ na nrụgide edoro, A 20 mL na B 60 mL na-emeghachi omume n'enweghị ịkarị ma ọ bụ ịgbagha ma mepụta C 40 mL. Oke molecule nke A bụ 28, nke B bụ 2, ma e mere ka ngwakọta gas 100 mL nke A na B (oke molecule nkezi 12.4) meghachi omume kpamkpam n'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide. Mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị, nkpuru ngwakọta gas bụ okpukpu ole nke tupu mmeghachi omume?
hints: N'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide, nkpuru nke gas na-adabere na oke molecule nkezi, ma a na-echekwa oke tupu na mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị, ya mere ọnụọgụ nkpuru = ọnụọgụ olu n'ụzọ nke ọzọ. Jiri oke molecule nkezi chọpụta olu A, B.

28x + 2(100 − x) = 12.4 × 100 → x = 40 mL (A), B = 60 mL. Ọnụọgụ olu mmeghachi omume A:B:C = 1:3:2 → B 60 mL niile meghachiri, A 20 mL ejiri, C 40 mL a mepụtara, A 20 mL fọdụrụ → ngụkọta mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị 60 mL.
chemistry-killer-09.explanation:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ọnụọgụ olu A:B:C = 20:60:40 = 1:3:2, ya bụ $\mathrm{A + 3B \rightarrow 2C}$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: N'ime ngwakọta gas 100 mL, olu A bụ x: (28x + 2(100 − x))/100 = 12.4 → 26x + 200 = 1240 → x = 40 mL. Ya mere A 40 mL, B 60 mL.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Mgbe B 60 mL niile meghachiri, A 20 mL ejiri ma C 40 mL a mepụtara. Mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị A 20 mL + C 40 mL = 60 mL.
Nzọụkwụ 4: A na-echekwa oke (nyocha site na oke molecule: tupu mmeghachi omume 40×28 + 60×2 = 1240, mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị oke molecule C (28+3×2)/2 = 17, 20×28 + 40×17 = 1240). N'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide, nkpuru = oke/olu, ya mere mgbe/tupu = 100/60 = 5/3.
Azịza: 5/3 (a). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 3/5 bụ ọnụọgụ edere n'ụzọ nke ọzọ, 1 lere naanị nchekwa oke anya ma leghara mgbanwe olu anya, 5/4 weere na A 40 mL fọdụrụ ma tụọ ngụkọta dị ka 80 mL)

chemistry-killer-10.prompt:
Nke a bụ equilibrium nke mmeghachi omume mmepụta ammonia. $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) ightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (mmeghachi omume exothermic). N'ime arịa mechiri emechi nke nwere okpomọkụ edoro, mgbe ha ruru equilibrium, e gbanwere ọnọdụ n'ụzọ ndị a n'otu n'otu wee ruo equilibrium ọhụrụ.
(A) Debe okpomọkụ edoro ma belata olu arịa.
(B) Debe olu edoro ma bulie okpomọkụ.
(C) Debe okpomọkụ na olu edoro ma tinye Ar(g) nke na-anaghị emeghachi omume.
(D) Debe okpomọkụ na nrụgide (ngụkọta nrụgide) edoro ma tinye Ar(g) ka olu bawanye.
(E) Debe okpomọkụ na olu edoro ma tinye $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$.
Kedu nhọrọ na-ahọrọ naanị ọnọdụ ndị ebe ọnụọgụ (mol) nke $\mathrm{NH_3}$ n'equilibrium ọhụrụ na-abawanye karịa equilibrium mbụ?
hints: Ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier: equilibrium na-agbagharị n'ụzọ na-ebelata mgbanwe ahụ. Mole gas tupu na mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị bụ 4 → 2 (na-ebelata), mmeghachi omume n'ihu bụ exothermic.

(A) Nrụgide na-abawanye → ụzọ mole na-ebelata (mmeghachi omume n'ihu). (B) Okpomọkụ na-arị elu → ụzọ endothermic (mmeghachi omume azụ). (C) Olu·okpomọkụ edoro, ịtinye Ar → enweghị mgbanwe ọnụọgụ nke gas ọ bụla → enweghị mgbagharị. (D) Nrụgide edoro, ịtinye Ar → olu na-abawanye (nrụgide akụkụ na-ebelata) → ụzọ mole na-abawanye (mmeghachi omume azụ). (E) Ịtinye $\mathrm{H_2}$ → mmeghachi omume n'ihu.
chemistry-killer-10.explanation:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Mole gas na-emeghachi omume bụ mole reactants 4 → mole ngwaahịa 2. Mmeghachi omume n'ihu bụ exothermic.
Nzọụkwụ 2: (A) Olu na-ebelata = nrụgide na-abawanye → equilibrium na-agbagharị n'ụzọ mmeghachi omume n'ihu nke na-ebelata mole gas → NH3 na-abawanye.
(B) Okpomọkụ na-arị elu → mmeghachi omume azụ nke bụ ụzọ endothermic → NH3 na-ebelata.
(C) N'olu edoro, ọbụlagodi ịtinye Ar, ọnụọgụ (nrụgide akụkụ) nke N2, H2, NH3 adịghị agbanwe, ya mere Q = K na-adịgide → enweghị mgbagharị, NH3 adịghị agbanwe.
(D) N'nrụgide edoro, ịtinye Ar na-eme ka olu dịkwuo ukwuu ma ọnụọgụ gas na-emeghachi omume niile na-ebelata → equilibrium na-agbagharị n'ụzọ mmeghachi omume azụ nke na-abawanye mole gas → NH3 na-ebelata.
(E) Ịtinye $\mathrm{H_2}$ → Q < K → mmeghachi omume n'ihu → akụkụ H2 na-eji ma NH3 na-abawanye (ọnụọgụ mol nke NH3 na-abawanye).
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ọnọdụ ebe ọnụọgụ NH3 na-abawanye: (A), (E).
Azịza: (A), (E) (b).

chemistry-killer-11.prompt:
Maka mmeghachi omume $\mathrm{N_2O_4(g) ightleftharpoons 2NO_2(g)}$, concentration equilibrium constant n'okpomọkụ edoro bụ $K = 0.4$ (a hapụrụ nkeji). N'okpomọkụ a, etinyere $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ na $\mathrm{NO_2}$ n'ime arịa atọ ma hapụ ha ogologo oge zuru ezu.
(A) olu 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.4 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
(B) olu 0.5 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.1 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.2 mol
(C) olu 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.2 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
Tụnyere reaction quotient $Q$ na $K$, kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma ụzọ mmeghachi omume na-eme n'arịa ọ bụla tupu ọ ruo equilibrium?

options.a: (A) n'ọnọdụ equilibrium, (B) n'ọnọdụ equilibrium, (C) mmeghachi omume azụ
options.b: (A) mmeghachi omume n'ihu, (B) mmeghachi omume n'ihu, (C) n'ọnọdụ equilibrium
options.c: (A) mmeghachi omume n'ihu, (B) mmeghachi omume azụ, (C) n'ọnọdụ equilibrium
options.d: (A) mmeghachi omume azụ, (B) mmeghachi omume n'ihu, (C) n'ọnọdụ equilibrium

hints: Tinye molarity (mol/L) n'ime $Q = \frac{[\mathrm{NO_2}]^2}{[\mathrm{N_2O_4}]}$ (ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ mole). Ọ bụrụ na Q < K mmeghachi omume n'ihu, Q > K mmeghachi omume azụ, Q = K equilibrium.
chemistry-killer-11.explanation:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ịgbakọ ọnụọgụ. (A) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.4/2.0 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M. (B) 0.5 L: [N2O4] = 0.1/0.5 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 M. (C) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.1 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Ịgbakọ Q. (A) Q = 0.2²/0.2 = 0.2 < 0.4 → mmeghachi omume n'ihu. (B) Q = 0.4²/0.2 = 0.8 > 0.4 → mmeghachi omume azụ. (C) Q = 0.2²/0.1 = 0.4 = K → ọnọdụ equilibrium.
Azịza: (A) mmeghachi omume n'ihu, (B) mmeghachi omume azụ, (C) ọnọdụ equilibrium (c). (Azịza ezighi ezi: Ọ bụrụ na e jiri mole gbakọọ Q, (A) 0.4²/0.4 = 0.4, (B) 0.2²/0.1 = 0.4, ya mere a ga-eche na ha abụọ nọ n'equilibrium n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi.)

chemistry-killer-12.prompt: N'ime 25 °C, $\mathrm{p}K_a$ nke acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) bụ 4.7. E gwakọtara 100 mL nke 0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ na 100 mL nke 0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ ka ọ bụrụ buffer solution. Mgbe agbakwunyere 10 mL nke 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ na ya, kedu pH nke ngwọta? (Mgbanwe ọnụọgụ n'ihi mgbanwe olu adịghị emetụta ngụkọta ọnụọgụ, ma jiri $\log 2 = 0.30$. Mgbe a na-agwakọta, NaOH na-emeghachi omume kpamkpam na acetic acid.)
hints: Jiri usoro Henderson–Hasselbalch $\mathrm{pH = p}K_a + \log\frac{[\mathrm{A^-}]}{[\mathrm{HA}]}$, ma buru ụzọ chọpụta ọnụọgụ mole gbanwere site na mmeghachi omume NaOH na HA ($\mathrm{OH^- + HA \rightarrow A^- + H_2O}$).
Mbụ: HA = 0.20 × 0.100 = 20 mmol, A⁻ = 0.10 × 0.100 = 10 mmol. Ịgbakwunye NaOH = 10 mmol → HA = 10 mmol, A⁻ = 20 mmol → [A⁻]/[HA] = 2.
chemistry-killer-12.explanation:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Mole mbụ. HA = 20 mmol, A⁻ = 10 mmol (pH mbụ = 4.7 + log 0.5 = 4.7 − 0.30 = 4.4).
Nzọụkwụ 2: NaOH 1.0 M × 10 mL = 10 mmol → n'ime $\mathrm{OH^- + HA \rightarrow A^- + H_2O}$, HA na-ebelata 10 mmol, A⁻ na-abawanye 10 mmol. HA = 10 mmol, A⁻ = 20 mmol.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ebe ha nọ n'otu ngwọta, ọnụọgụ concentration = ọnụọgụ mole = 2. pH = 4.7 + log 2 = 4.7 + 0.30 = 5.0.
Azịza: 5.0 (d). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 4.4 bụ pH tupu agbakwunye NaOH, 4.7 bụ ịtụ na HA na A⁻ ghọrọ otu n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi, 5.3 bụ ịtụ ọnụọgụ dị ka 4)
